integrity: Finite determinant/SCC computations are independently reproducible from the included standalone script; small-n state enumeration is corroborative rather than an all-size proof. The all-size proof relies on explicit cyclic-walk bijections, exact finite matrix identities and Perron--Frobenius theory. Scientific self-review only, no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact scope: graph C_n square P_3 for n>=3, strict open-neighbour majority with tie retention, recurrent state counts, and asymptotic rates only. The general matrix method and period-two principle are prior work. No transient cutoff or attraction basin theorem. An inaccessible 1988 general-method full text and possible unindexed equivalent remain originality risks.
title: Algebraic recurrent-state growth for majority dynamics on three-row cylinders
